title: moeb-tool-origin: Read called on spec.skill.md without MissingMoebTool signal
description: During run 004c6afb-9d83-474f-bc34-1046fffa1cfd, the native Read tool was called on src/moeb/internal/skills/spec.skill.md (lines 164-226) to inspect Phase 5 content before patching, instead of using the available read_file_range moeb tool. No MissingMoebTool signal was buffered for this call. read_file_range was available and would have served this purpose.
proposed_resolution: Use read_file_range for bounded reads on known-path source files during a moeb run; buffer a MissingMoebTool signal whenever a native tool is used because no moeb equivalent exists.
